Round 5, read against the report itself. Report, dated 09/11/2026, title 'Activites cyber offensives menees par des acteurs iraniens lies au CGRI'. Issuer: 'Le C4 est une instance interministerielle'; 'Le C4 rassemble l'ANSSI, le COMCYBER, la DGA, la DGSE et la DGSI.' Attribution for the refrigeration attack: 'un faisceau d'indices indiquant le Corps des Gardiens de la Revolution Islamique iranien comme commanditaire' and 'l'unite cyber-offensive Shahid Kaveh comme executante'; introduction: 'en mesure d'imputer aux unites cyber-offensives Shahid Shoostari et Shahid Kaveh, operant au sein du Centre electronique et cyber' (CGRI-CEC). Annex: Mahdi Lashgarian and Reza Salarvand, each 'Commandant de Shahid Kaveh'; the third person named, Hamid Reza Lashgarian, heads the CGRI-CEC. 'Names two of its commanders' is exact. FACT is right for what the document states. One omission, not blocking: the parenthetical leaves out the DGA (defence procurement agency), a C4 member that is neither cyber command nor an intelligence service.

verdicts.evidence: Round 5, read against the report itself. 'That the unit did it remains an accusation.' ALLEGED is the right tag: the report's own confidence wording is 'un faisceau d'indices indiquant' ('a body of indicators pointing to'); there is no stated confidence level and no flat 'le C4 attribue'. Iran denies it (NPR).

Round 5, read against the report itself. Whole bullet: 'The evidence it describes: the same infrastructure scanning Schneider Electric equipment at small energy and water sites since April 2026, a scanning tool the unit is said to use regularly, a propaganda outlet that relayed the attack from Oct. 13, and "traces of Farsi" in the attack infrastructure. It calls this "a body of indicators."' Holds: same infrastructure ('L'infrastructure utilisee pour mener l'attaque a egalement ete utilisee, au cours de la meme periode'); propaganda outlet ('relayee sur l'organe de propagande CyberbanNews, associe a l'unite Shahid Kaveh, des le 13 octobre 2026'); Farsi ('Des traces d'utilisation du farsi ont ete retrouvees dans l'infrastructure d'attaque'); 'faisceau d'indices'. Three details go past the report, and a FACT tag on a summary of a primary document needs them right. (1) Where the scanning was aimed: the report describes Schneider Electric equipment 'utilises notamment dans des petites et moyennes unites de production d'energie et d'eau', i.e. the kind of equipment such sites use; it does not say the scanned devices were at small energy and water sites. (Separately, it says Schneider equipment at small hydroelectric sites was targeted alongside the refrigeration attack.) (2) 'Since April 2026' drops the hedge: 'depuis avril 2026 a minima', at least since April. (3) The tool: 'Cet outil est habituellement utilise par le mode operatoire d'attaque', the intrusion set, which that sentence does not tie to Shahid Kaveh by name. 'The unit is said to use' turns the attack group into the unit.
verdicts.fix: The evidence it describes: the attack infrastructure was also used, since at least April 2026, to scan for a type of Schneider Electric equipment used in small energy and water plants; the attackers used a scanning tool the report says the attack group habitually uses; a propaganda outlet the report links to the unit relayed the attack from Oct. 13; and "traces of Farsi" were found in the attack infrastructure. It calls this "a body of indicators."

Round 5, read against the report itself. Whole bullet: 'We read France's report (CERTFR-2026-CTI-009). It publishes no indicators of compromise that outsiders could test, and it does not mention Danfoss, the November wave or the blood service. We found no public independent confirmation and no other government joining the attribution.' (FACT). First two sentences are right and FACT fits them: no IP addresses, hashes or domains are listed (the only IP reference, 'deux adresses IP appartenant a des FAI iraniens', is in the 2024 Olympics section and gives none); Danfoss, the November 2026 wave and the EFS do not appear (the only November is a November 2023 Unitronics campaign). The third sentence is accurate today (no other government found in a search on Nov. 10; no public independent confirmation in Reuters, NPR, The Record or TechTimes), but it is a status that can change, and it was tagged WATCH in rounds 1 to 4. Folding it under the FACT chip gives an open question the page's own label for settled fact ('FACT = primary document or two independent outlets'); neither applies to an absence.
